steps.say: Your Markdown notes can finally highlight themselves. Zettlr, the free writing app built for notes and papers, just shipped callouts.
Version four point eight arrived on September eighteenth, twenty twenty-six, after almost three months of development.
The headline feature is admonitions. You might know them as callouts or alerts: boxes that wrap text and colour it by type.
There are five — note, tip, info, warning and caution — and you write one with plain blockquote syntax, bracket exclamation NOTE on the first line.
Pre-rendering is on by default, so the box draws itself once your cursor leaves it, and you can turn it off in preferences.
steps.show: pre-rendering of admonitions is turned on

steps.say: One change to watch: full-text search now treats a space as AND, not OR. Two words means a file needs both.
Zettlr stays free and open source, on Mac, Windows and Linux, with no paid tier at all.
Open a note, type bracket exclamation TIP, and watch the box appear.
